title: HATCH gradient-stop retained text owner fast slice
mode: local fast implementation slice with generated controls
scope: Charge DXF HATCH gradient-stop groups 432/433 to per-stop retained-text ownership
Preserve transactional replacement and copy/move/reset accounting
Use generated ASCII controls without adding persistent DWG/DXF fixtures

implementation.summary: DRW_Hatch::parseCode now routes gradient-stop color and color-book names through replaceDxfRetainedStringField with private per-stop byte counters. A positional GradientStop constructor preserves the existing brace-initialization order/defaults while keeping the counters private. Generated controls verify replacement admission and lease lifetime through copy, assignment, move, reader teardown, and reset.
implementation.layoutChange: Two private retained-byte counters were added to the public nested GradientStop layout. A positional constructor preserves known source brace-initialization use; downstream consumers must rebuild and binary ABI compatibility is not claimed.

assessment.claim: The selected parser-owned DXF HATCH gradient-stop color and color-book names are charged to the shared logical retained-byte budget. Replacement at the exact peak succeeds; a one-byte-under attempt preserves the old spelling and lease. Copies retain accounting until final reset/destruction, and moves transfer it.
assessment.coverage: Generated ASCII controls cover exact-peak admission, reader teardown, copy construction/assignment, move construction/assignment, final reset release, and one-byte-under replacement preservation.
assessment.limitations: This does not bound allocation capacity or RSS, public post-parse mutation, writer/projection copies, other HATCH fields or semantics, DWG parsing, peer/native acceptance, or full-suite behavior.
